title: Fixing the Anonymous Scholarship List
script: Samira: [thoughtful] Jamal, I reviewed the scholarship spreadsheet. One applicant's name is visible in the notes column.
Jamal: That should not happen. Reviewers are supposed to see codes, not names.
Samira: [gently] The comment copied a sentence from her email and included her full signature.
Jamal: We need to remove it before the committee opens the file.
Samira: [carefully] Should I just delete the signature?
Jamal: Delete identifying details, then check whether the comment still contains a workplace or family name.
Samira: [reflective] You are right. The story itself may identify her in our small community.
Jamal: Can we replace it with a neutral summary of the financial circumstance?
Samira: [honestly] Yes, as long as we do not change facts that affect eligibility.
Jamal: I will write: “Unexpected family care costs reduced available tuition funds.”
Samira: [warmly] That keeps the relevant information without exposing private details.
Jamal: We should also check earlier rows. This may not be the only copied email.
Samira: [sincere] I can run a manual review of every note tonight. Will you check the result tomorrow?
Jamal: Yes. Two-person review is safer for sensitive data.
Samira: How should we tell the volunteer who entered it?
Jamal: Privately and without blame. The instructions were not clear enough about copying messages.
Samira: Then we also need to update the form and training example.
Jamal: Agreed. A good system should make the right action easy, not depend only on memory.
Samira: The committee meeting is on Friday, so we have time to correct it properly.
Jamal: Good. Protecting an applicant's dignity is part of judging the scholarship fairly.

quiz.question: What problem appears in the spreadsheet?
quiz.explanation: A copied signature broke anonymous review.

quiz.question: What must Samira check beyond the signature?
quiz.explanation: Indirect details can also identify a person.

quiz.question: What neutral summary do they create?
options: Family care costs reduced tuition funds
quiz.explanation: The summary preserves relevant facts without identity.

quiz.question: How will they address the volunteer?
quiz.explanation: Correction includes both respect and system improvement.

quiz.question: Why does anonymity matter?
options: It protects dignity and fair judgment

quiz.question: Why might deleting the signature be insufficient?
options: The committee needs the full email
The name appears only on paper
Other details may still identify the applicant locally

quiz.question: What information must the neutral summary preserve?
quiz.explanation: Anonymization should not change the fair decision basis.

quiz.question: Why will Jamal check Samira’s review?
options: Sensitive data is safer with a second careful review
Jamal wants to rank applicants alone

quiz.question: Why do they avoid blaming the volunteer?
options: The instructions and example also failed to guide the action
quiz.explanation: They repair both the error and its system cause.

quiz.question: What does “make the right action easy” imply?
options: Forms and training should guide safe data entry
